scientific_integrity: Self-review verified the definitions, spectral gap, perturbation formula, and exact strict coefficient ordering. No independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed bounded real mean-zero angular profiles and sufficiently small deformations of an interior centered disk; second-order operator-norm shape expansion only. No global uniform nonlinear stability bound or all-spectrum assertion; historical priority is provisional. The monomial moment calculations, perturbation expansion, and Fourier-ordering argument provide a complete mathematical proof; supplementary finite tests are not proofs of infinite-dimensional statements.
title: Sharp local shape Hessian for hyperbolic Bergman–wavelet concentration
